instruction: Disable the 'Format On Save' feature in the workspace settings for this project.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully saved project as workspace by navigating File > Save Workspace As, navigating breadcrumbs to /home/user/, and saving project.code-workspace in 5 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VS Code menus, use file dialogs, breadcrumb navigation, interact with VS Code UI
metadata.task_rationale: Tests modifying workspace settings in VS Code. The initial setup includes .vscode/settings.json with editor.formatOnSave set to true, so the agent must change it to false.
metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling format on save in workspace settings. The original .vscode/settings.json has 'editor.formatOnSave': true. Evaluator reads the workspace settings.json and checks that editor.formatOnSave is false.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads /home/user/project/.vscode/settings.json via env.controller.get_file() and returns parsed JSON under 'settings' key
Metric correctly handles expected parameter (direct access to rules dict): extracts 'setting_key' and 'expected_value' without incorrect nesting
Metric comparison logic correctly checks result['settings']['editor.formatOnSave'] == false, which is the exact verification needed
Complete coverage: instruction has single requirement (disable format on save) and evaluator checks exactly that
Expected value 'editor.formatOnSave: false' is the correct VS Code setting key and value for disabling format on save
Postconfig activates VS Code window and triggers Ctrl+S to ensure any pending changes are flushed to disk before getter reads the file
